environment.description: Same Flask application deployed on the same EC2 instance type behind an ALB. AWS WAFv2 WebACL is attached to the ALB with the following rule configuration: (1) AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with SizeRestrictions_QUERYSTRING rule action override set to BLOCK at threshold, and (2) a custom rate-based rule. Additionally, the ALB has a custom listener rule that inspects query string parameters: any request to path-pattern '/api/products/report*' where the query-string key 'having' is present is routed to a fixed-response action returning HTTP 422 with body '{"error":"parameter not permitted"}'. This listener rule has priority 1 (evaluated before the default forward rule).
